root_cause.text: The `mesh_matches_local()` function in the mac80211 subsystem unconditionally dereferences the `ie->mesh_config` pointer without verifying if it is NULL, which can be triggered when processing a Channel Switch Announcement (CSA) action frame that lacks a Mesh Configuration Information Element (IE).
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a NULL check `if (!ie->mesh_config) return false;` at the beginning of `mesh_matches_local()` in `net/mac80211/mesh.c`, and the commit message states that `mesh_rx_csa_frame()` passes raw parsed elements to `mesh_matches_local()` without guarding `mesh_config`, leading to a NULL pointer dereference when accessing `ie->mesh_config->meshconf_psel`.
